spec.headline: Hosting this holiday? Know your liability
points: A guest slips on icy steps

entries.caption:
Holiday hosting season is here. If a guest slips on your icy front steps, do you know how your home policy would respond? 🏠

Most homeowners and renters policies include PERSONAL LIABILITY coverage. If you're found responsible for a guest's injury, it can help pay for their medical bills and your legal defense, up to your policy's limit. Many policies also include MEDICAL PAYMENTS coverage, which can help with a guest's smaller medical bills regardless of who was at fault.

A few easy ways to keep guests safe:
• Clear and de-ice steps, walkways and the driveway
• Light up entryways and stairs
• Keep pets secured when the door is opening a lot

Not sure what your liability limits are? Call or text (425) 419-0099 for a free coverage review.

Coverage varies by policy, state and eligibility.
